lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Cs4Na2Y2S8 (reduced formula Cs2NaYS4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Na and Y each adopt tetrahedral S coordination, while Cs centers have nine geometric neighbors (three Cs, six S). The same analysis identifies corner-sharing between Na and Y tetrahedra, corner-sharing among Y tetrahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cs polyhedra, with the geometric neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
